integrity.finite_checker_limit: Two through six types in various comparisons; not an all-parameter proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact product semigroup, strong Markov resolvent, alternating polynomial root signs, strict convexity and budget extremizers.

scientific_limitations: PGF/Laplace-transform order is proved; usual stochastic order is not asserted.
Uniform coupon-type selection, independent Bernoulli refresh and first simultaneous presence are essential stated assumptions.
The earlier finite heterogeneous generating identity and the classical geometric coupon decomposition are not claimed as original.
Historical priority relative to broad general product-chain inequalities is not independently established.
title: Interlacing geometric factors and sharp loss budgets in clumsy coupon collection
